# PhysxVehicleContextAPI

Scene-wide vehicle settings (update mode, vertical and longitudinal axes) on a PhysicsScene [prim](glossary.md#prim). Listing it turns on vehicle parsing for the attach; the walkers emit one vehicle context per PhysicsScene that lists it.

- **Applies to:** `PhysicsScene`
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Interactions

- **[`PhysicsScene`](PhysicsScene.md):** On a prim that is not a PhysicsScene the [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) walker ignores the API silently and the [USD](glossary.md#usd) walker logs an error. The contexts are set on their scenes after all scenes are loaded and before any vehicle is created.

## Notes

- The parser reads physxVehicleContext:updateMode, verticalAxis and longitudinalAxis, falling back to the deprecated upAxis and forwardAxis when an axis token is undefined, and the runtime applies live changes of the first three. They are not described yet.
